answer: At epoch close, each identity commits a Merkle root of its answers. Then audits drill the backlog like test holes in the tundra: a random draw sends one past answer per identity to a fresh three-grader jury, checking the record builds a mesa of solid work rather than flat paint. A re-grade 2 or more points below the original freezes pending rewards for 7 epochs. A Sybil mill stamping one template across 100 identities gets caught fast, and 100 flags lock 700,000 POA for 7 epochs. Old answers keep their pigment under a second look; templates fade.
